definitions.explanation: The amount of time it takes to travel between home and workplace.

examples.japanese: {通勤時間|つうきんじかん}は{片道|かたみち}1{時間|じかん}だ。
examples.english: My commute time is one hour each way.

examples.japanese: {通勤時間|つうきんじかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}したい。
examples.english: I want to shorten my commute time.

examples.japanese: {通勤時間|つうきんじかん}に{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: I read books during my commute.

notes:
{通勤時間|つうきんじかん} is a compound of {通勤|つうきん} (commuting to work) + {時間|じかん} (time). It can mean either the duration of the commute or the time period when commuting occurs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通勤時間|つうきんじかん}が{長|なが}い/{短|みじか}い: commute is long/short
- {通勤時間|つうきんじかん}を{利用|りよう}する: to make use of commute time
- {通勤時間帯|つうきんじかんたい}: commuting hours, rush hour
- {片道|かたみち}の{通勤時間|つうきんじかん}: one-way commute time

CULTURAL NOTE:
Long commutes are common in Japan, especially in the Tokyo area where {片道|かたみち}1{時間|じかん}（one hour each way）is typical. Many commuters use this time for reading, studying, or sleeping.

RELATED WORDS:
- {通勤|つうきん}: commuting
- {通勤電車|つうきんでんしゃ}: commuter train
- {通勤ラッシュ|つうきんらっしゅ}: commuter rush
- {通学時間|つうがくじかん}: school commute time
